articleTitle: Automatic Voltage Regulator with Particle Swarm Optimized Model Predictive Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Automatic Voltage Regulator (AVR) plays an important role in keeping voltage stability in the power system network. Since the performance of AVR gets affected due to the presence of load inertia and field circuit dynamics, it is important to take it into account while designing a control strategy. In this paper, efforts have been made to design a Model Predictive Controller based robust control strategy for the AVR system which gives good transient response characteristics as well as robustness against the external disturbance and parameter variation. The Model Predictive Controller weights of the system have been fine-tuned with the help of Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm for further improvement in vital performance indices.

articleTitle: Secure Card-less ATM Transactions
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: With the constant developments in technology we have certainly advanced a lot in terms of digital payments. The increasing use of debit and credit cards in different fields has reduced manual efforts to a large extent thereby making payments at and for various tasks way too convenient. This ease comes with the associated risks as technological advancement and cyber- crime go hand-in-hand. In recent years, cash withdrawal through ATM cards has seen an increase in the number of card related frauds; card cloning, shoulder surfing, fake keyboard, skimming etc. being a few of them. To combat these problems, we propose a Secure Cardless Transaction System- a method which would eliminate the usage of ATM PIN and physical cards altogether and hence provide a secure environment for cash withdrawal. The concept of User-Generated One Time Password (OTP) has been introduced in this project. With all these modification in existing systems, the robustness of the machines will increase.

articleTitle: ANFIS Controlled Grid Connected Electric Vehicle Charging Station Using PV Source
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper provides an insight of electric vehicle charging station which is supplied by three sources grid, photovoltaic system (PVS) and battery energy system (BES), and this system works in both conditions like shore and offshore. Power grid, equipped with an AC/DC converter supplies a continuous and constant power to EV charging station through a DC/DC converter. BES used as a buffer by storing excessive energy at light load conditions and supplying it when needed. Control unit enables the bi-directional DC/DC converter for charging and discharging. Adaptive neuro fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) is used in control unit which improves the performance of the converters. MPPT (maximum power point tracking) technique is used to get the appropriate pulses for DC/DC converter to extract the maximum output power from PVS at different conditions. The proposed system is simulated in MATLAB/SIMULINK environment and results are discussed to validate the system.

articleTitle: Grid Connected Electric Vehicle Charging Station Using PV Source
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper provides an insight of electric vehicle charging station which is supplied by three sources grid, photovoltaic system (PVS) and battery energy system (BES), and this system works in both conditions like shore and offshore. Power grid, equipped with an AC/DC converter supplies a continuous and constant power to EV charging station through a DC/DC converters. BES used as a buffer by storing excessive energy at light load conditions and supplying it when needed. Control unit enables the bi-directional DC/DC converter for charging and discharging. MPPT (maximum power point tracking) technique is used to get the appropriate pulses for DC/DC converter to extract the maximum output power from PVS at different conditions. The proposed system is simulated in MATLAB/SIMULINK environment and results are discussed to validate the system.

articleTitle: A Fractional Order Particle Swarm Optimization for tuning Fractional Order PID Controller for Magnetic Levitation Plant
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: A magnetic levitation plant is an open loop unstable system. An efficient and robust controller, is therefore, necessary to stabilize the plant. This work presents the design of Fractional Order PID (FOPID) controller to stabilize the magnetic levitation system. The parameters of the FOPID controller have been tuned using Fractional Order Particle Swarm Optimization (FOPSO). In FOPSO, the velocity update equation of the original particle swarm optimization, is converted into a non-integer order equation. The non-integer velocity equation helps in smooth transition and exploration of the search space. An objective function has been formulated, which relates the performance of the system to the controller parameters. The performance of the FOPID controller tuned using FOPSO is compared with PID controller. It has been confirmed that the FOPID controller performs better and delivers superior response.

articleTitle: Fault Tolerance Study of Symmetrical Six-Phase Induction Drive
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper presents a fault tolerance study of symmetrical six-phase induction drive (SSID) in cases of fault occurs within the inverter. This analysis deals with the different types of fault in inverter power electronic components, namely: one-leg open, two-legs open and short circuit of one switch. The inquiring simulation model of the effects of inverter faults on six-phase induction motor drive before or after the fault operation on MATLAB/Simulink, to study the effects on motor performance and compare with the healthy phase condition. The result shows that the motor is able to continue in operation due to the presence of torque pulsation and can be used to improving the drive performance by using a fault tolerant controller. To conquer these effects on motor drive performance, there are three fault tolerant topologies of six-phase voltage source inverter (VSI) are intimated.

articleTitle: Automated Classification of Glaucoma Using Retinal Fundus Images
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Glaucoma is an irreversible chronic eye illness that prompts vision loss. It progresses slowly without easily noticeable symptoms. Computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) of glaucoma in the early stage is needed, which is fast and more accurate. In this work, the empirical wavelet transform (EWT) and correntropy (CE) feature-based novel method has been proposed for the classification of glaucoma stages. In the proposed method (PM), the preprocessed fundus images are decomposed into various frequency components using EWT decomposition technique. Further, correntropy based features are calculated from decomposed EWT components. Afore, student’s t-test algorithm has been applied for the selection of significant features and features with higher t value are ranked first. Finally, random forest (RF) classifier is used for classification of glaucoma stages. The obtained classification accuracy using tenfold cross-validation is 91.48% and 94% for two-class and three-class classification, respectively. The proposed method is ready to assist the ophthalmologist to diagnose glaucoma.

articleTitle: UDE based Sliding Mode Control for Octocopter
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Octocopter system consists of nonlinear, under-actuated and MIMO dynamics. External disturbances acting on octocopter can affect the flight stability of octocopter. In the presented work, the external disturbances are affecting the altitude and attitude states of multi-rotor system. An uncertainty and disturbance estimator (UDE) based sliding mode control (SMC) strategy is proposed to achieve flight stability for a nonlinear octocopter dynamics operating in the presence of external disturbances. The proposed robust control approach does not require any information such as a priori knowledge of disturbance bound and also addresses the the issue of chattering phenomena, a major concern in SMC design. It is also observed that efficiency of actuators can be increased in the absence of chattering phenomena. Efficacy of the proposed design is shown through simulations and comparison with the SMC based controller design.

articleTitle: Power Quality Events’ Classification employing Discrete Wavelet Transform and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: The Power Quality (PQ) studies have gained huge attention from the academics and the industry over the past three decades. The excessive use of power semiconductor devices in a grid utility increases the malfunction of the control system, produces Power Quality Disturbances (PQDs) and reduces the electric component life. The accurate detection and classification of PQDs in power system is key step to determine the causes of these events before any proper counter measure could be taken. Most of disturbances are non-stationary and transitory in nature; hence it requires advanced tools and techniques for the analysis of PQDs. In this paper, mathematical parametric models are used to acquire the PQ signals as per the definition provided in IEEE 1159-2009 Standards. The acquired signals are then to extract the distinctive features using Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) signal processing technique. Finally, the signals are classified using two machine learning algorithm (MLA) based classifiers; K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) and Naive Bayes (NB). The proposed method is further validated in presence of noise accompanied PQ signals too.

articleTitle: Power efficient FIR filter Architecture using Distributed Arithmetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Multiply and accumulate (MAC) unit is a significant part of the FIR filter design. It is the MAC unit that determines the efficiency of an FIR filter. Many factors like area, power consumption, speed and other key factors are determined by the way the MAC unit is implemented from the programming stage to the final implementation. In this paper, two MAC methods namely, Multiple constant multiplication (MCM) method and Distributed Arithmetic (DA) method are computed using a simulation and synthesis tool and are compared in terms of power consumption to determine the power efficient method. MCM method being a traditional method requires more number of multipliers and adders. Whereas, DA method involves the Look up table to access the filter coefficients continuously, being run by a clock and thereby, results to be a power efficient method.

articleTitle: Torque Ripple Minimization of PMSM Drive using DTFC-SVM based Control Strategy for Five-Level Cascaded Symmetrical H-Bridge Inverter
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper presents, direct torque and flux control with space vector modulation (DTFC-SVM) based control strategy for PMSM drive with reduced torque ripple operation. DTFC- SVM is an agile control strategy in motor drive applications, it has the ability to produce a greater number of voltage vectors compared to Direct Torque Control (DTC). Multilevel concept is an added advantage in motor control applications, helps to reduce the current THD with increased levels. Three Level NPC has a neutral point voltage balancing issue, which can be eliminated in five level structure and more number of switching states allows reduced THD and further helps for torque ripple minimization. Five-level SVM implementation simplified by using a two-level SVM structure. DTFC-SVM based control strategy discussed for both three level NPC and five level cascaded H-bridge Inverters. Compared Steady state torque and current ripples with improved machine dynamics under different operating conditions in MATLAB/SIMULINK software environment.

Author Keywords: Interior type permanent magnet synchronous motor drive

articleTitle: Analysis of Basic Adder with Parallel Prefix Adder
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Adders are the important and essential block of the digital circuit. It performs the addition in a digital circuit and so the overall performance of the digital circuit depends on the selection of a suitable adder. The proper selection of adder is needed to reduce the extra laborious work and complexity of a digital system. In this paper, we are comparing the different adders that have been synthesized using Xilinx synthesis tool and simulated using Verilog hardware description language and Xilinx simulation tool. The output of the simulation data helps in observing the different properties of adder. These properties get on the difference in operation and execution of the adders. Han Carlson Adder (HCA), Kogge Stone Adder (KSA), Carry Select Adder (CSLA), Carry Skip Adder (CSKA), Carry Look Ahead Adder (CLA) and Ripple Carry Adder (RCA) have been compared with help of three basic aspects namely, device utilization i.e., number of slices, delay and power.

articleTitle: Multi-Model Predictive Control (MMPC) for Non-linear Systems with Time Delay: An Experimental Investigation
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper depicts an experimental validation and comparison of gap metric based weighting methods for nonlinear processes with delay using Multi-model predictive control (MMPC). Controlling nonlinear processes is a difficult task and the difficulty increases when there is time delay in the process. Multi model technique is the simplest approach and is used to control the nonlinear process from decades. In this research, model predictive control is developed in a multi model framework (MMPC). In MMPC the global controller formation depends on local weights and these weights are calculated based on gap metric. From the literature, we found two popular weighing functions based on gap metric. Here we present the comparative performance analysis of those weighing functions through simulation and experimental studies. Level control in a conical tank process is cosnidered for experimental implementation of the considered weighting methods in MMPC framework.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Controller Design for Retrofitted Three-wheeled Hybrid Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: In a country like India, almost all of the vehicles on road uses internal combustion(IC) engine. Pollution and diminishing fossil fuel reserves has triggered a slow but administered shift back to electric vehicles. In 2015, the government of India devised plans to promote hybrid and electric vehicles in India. But even today, hybrid and electric vehicles fail to impress a vast majority of population. One reason for this is the high cost for conversion to hybrid or electric vehicle. Another reason being the low range of electric vehicles compared to IC engined vehicles. To cope with these challenges and to better utilize the existing IC engines, hybrid electric power-train is used. This paper focuses on controller design for conversion of IC engined vehicle into a hybrid electric one using after-market electric motor and its accessories. The objective of proposed work is to deliver a cheaper and better retrofit design for converting existing vehicles to hybrid-electric. It is also ensured that the proposed design does not create high cost and time overhead to the consumer. The sensor designs, the controller limits and actuator designs will be explored in a practical sense for a three wheeler.

articleTitle: Modelling and Control of Non-Isolated Multiport DC/DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper analyzes a non-isolated multiport DCDC boost converter. The converter makes use of just one inductor compensating the space constraints in various applications. This converter presented hereby uses two input sources and feeds the power to two distinct loads. The multiport converter feeds output at different multiple voltages, making it appropriate for DC distribution systems and EV applications. Future renewable DC sources can be integrated with the converter for simpler control. Discharging mode of the converter is modelled and analyzed. Averaged state space model is created to remove non-linearity due to switching and further small signal analysis is performed and transfer functions are obtained. Using these transfer functions, bode plots are obtained for controller design and controllers such as PI and ANN are simulated and compared to evaluate system performance. Simulated results validate the performance of the multiport converter.

articleTitle: Design of PI Controller for Space Vector Modulation based Direct Flux and Torque Control of PMSM Drive
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper studies the space vector modulated - direct flux and torque control of permanent magnet synchronous motor, due to occurrence of high torque ripples and variable switching frequency of conventional direct flux and torque control strategy. Using dynamic model, the relation between field fluxes of stator, voltages maintained across stator and electromagnetic torque developed for the permanent magnet synchronous motor are developed. Accordingly, the closed loop feedback control structures of torque and flux is established, where the proportional and integral controllers are used to generate the output voltages by regulating the error signals. Furthermore, controller parameters are designed by analyzing the frequency models of torque and flux control loops. The mathematical expressions for obtaining control parameters with target set and physical significance meaning are obtained with high accuracy. Thereby, designing of PI controller parameters for the control structures of flux and closed loop structure of torque becomes easier in the direct flux and torque control with space vector modulation technology, and accurate control of flux and developed torque can be achieved. Simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed technology and the possibility of designing the parameters of closed loop controllers.

Author Keywords: and design of PI controller parameters

articleTitle: Different Control Scheme for the Quadcopter: A Brief Tour
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper given brief tour on the different control techniques for the quadcopter that can improve the flight control stability and trajectory tracking of a quadcopter. Four main control techniques have been studied: Linear, Nonlinear, Intelligent control and Hybrid control technique. Each has its point of strength and weakness.

articleTitle: Throughput Enhancement of IEEE 802.11ah RAW Mechanism using ANN
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: IEEE 802.11ah reduces the number of collisions and improves energy efficiency by implementing the restricted access window (RAW) mechanism. The RAW mechanism partitions the network and allows each group to access the channel in a RAW slot. Finding optimal RAW parameters plays a vital role in enhancing network performance. In this article, we formulate an optimization problem using the artificial neural network to find the optimal number of RAW slots and to improve network performance. The results show that the proposed optimization problem improves the throughput of the RAW mechanism. Finally, the analytical findings are validated using ns-3 simulations.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of Wireless Network by Adopting Downlink Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access Technique
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) has been achieving remarkable support in the surroundings of next generation communication system. The key advantages of this particular scheme includes high data rates, higher spectral and energy efficiency compared to its various orthogonal schemes. The upcoming next generation (5G) wireless networks requires high data rate as well as higher spectral and energy efficiency with very fast development of Internet of Things (IoT). In this paper, power domain based non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) scheme we adopted, which have been compared with already existing orthogonal scheme that is orthogonal frequency division multiple access (OFDMA) scheme. The simulation results show that the proposed NOMA scheme achieves much more data rate with higher spectral and energy efficiency as compared with existing technique.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Multioutput Flyback Converter under Continuous and Discontinuous Conduction mode using PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: During the rise of space technology in 1960 which led to the increase in development of power supplies that are efficient, highly reliable, light weight and small. The ideas were injected by the researchers and engineers in the field of power electronics and switch mode power supplies came into existence. Analysis and design of DC-DC converters which offers high efficiency, small converters with the implementation of isolation transformer can have numerous outputs of various magnitude and polarities. The regulated power supplies of these converters have wide application in the areas like industrial automation, digital systems, charging stations etc. where in a low voltage, high current with low ripple power supply has significant role. This paper analyzes and design the Multioutput Flyback converter (230V DC - 180V/5V DC).

articleTitle: Investigation of the Suitability of Adaptive Extended Kalman Filter for Power System Harmonics Estimation
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper address the task of harmonic estimation of a power signal which is perturbed with Gaussian white noise. Along with the harmonic parameters, the fundamental frequency is also needs to be estimated which makes the estimation problem significantly nonlinear. Harmonic estimation problems often suffers from the incomplete knowledge of process noise covariance (Q). This paper investigates the estimation performance of two variants of Q-Adaptive Extended Kalman filter (QA-EKF) in simulation which have been rarely employed for harmonics estimation. Based on extensive simulation results the authors recommend a suitable variety of QA-EKF that demonstrates superior estimation performance over its competing estimation algorithms.

articleTitle: Auto Tuning of Decentralized PI Controllers for a Non-Square Unstable MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: For a non-square unstable multi input and multi output system, simultaneous relay auto tuning method is applied to get the PI controller parameter for decentralized control system. The higher order harmonics are considered in analyzing the sustained oscillation in the outputs. The performance of the decentralized control system is analyzed by simulation on a 3 input and 2 output system using MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: IMU based Tracking of a Person using Nonlinear Autoregressive Exogenous(NARX) Algorithm in GPS-denied Areas
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Global Positioning System(GPS) is a prominent way to track a person or a vehicle in the outdoor scenarios. In indoor, underground and urban canyons there is no Line-Of- Sight communication due to signal blockage, which results into weak or completely lost GPS signals. Such areas are classified as GPS-denied areas. Tracking becomes challenging in such areas. In this paper, a method is proposed in which tracking is done using IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) sensor data, and NARX, a type of RNN, is used for prediction of the current location in GPS-denied areas. The GPS coordinates just before entering the GPS denied area and the features extracted from the IMU data are given as inputs to the NARX and the current GPS coordinates are predicted.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of DFOC and IFOC for IM Drive
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative analysis of direct field-oriented control (DFOC) and indirect field-oriented control (IFOC). The speed control of IM drives is one of the challenging issues at low speed region, where the steady-state performance is the smoother but the dynamic response is poor. The vector control provides a smoother steady-state and transient response. In the vector control, the information of the rotor angle is essential. The rotor angle is measured from Hall sensors or by estimating with the adaptive scheme. But the installation of sensors in the machine shaft is complex and costly. The performance of DFOC and IFOC of IM fed with multi-level inverter is analyzed in the high speed and low speed operation respectively. The IFOC is suitable for low speed performance, while the DFOC for rated speed operation. The effectiveness of DFOC and IFOC is simulated using the MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Development of Novel Wireless Electronic Signature Stamp
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper presents an efficient way of reproducing electronic signatures using a Computerized Numeric Control (CNC) plotter mechanism. It aims to eliminate the use of distinct stamps by replacing it with a single customizable stamp. Generally, CNC machines are dependent on G and M codes for instructing the plotter. This work focuses on presenting a unique approach to bypass the use of these G-codes. The signature is wirelessly transferred from the Android application to the device and plotted on paper.

articleTitle: Predictive Maintenance Approach For Transformers Based On Hot Spot Detection In Thermal images
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Transformers are one of the most valuable equipment in substation. The operation of entire power system is strongly linked to reliable and accurate operation of this device. Therefore, the life assessment of transformers and their maintenance schedule is critical for efficient transmission and distribution of electric power. In this study an on-line predictive maintenance approach for transformers using thermal images has been suggested. Four segmentation approaches have been compared for hotspot detection in thermal images of transformers. The Modified Kmeans algorithm provides the best segmentation performance amongst the four algorithms studied in this work.

articleTitle: Homer Based: A Real Time Case Study on Optimization and Simulation of Hybrid Energy System at NIT Kurukshetra and the Effect on the Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: National Institute of Technology kurukshetra campus in Haryana has 1MW rooftop solar plant. The primary objective of this paper is to suggest a hybrid energy system available at the campus is economically feasible or not. In this paper, by using HOMER software (Hybrid Optimization of Multiple Energy Resources software), We analyze five completely distinct instants available at the NIT campus. The results are obtained by using HOMER software indicates hybrid energy system as a cost effective alternative solution for the campus.

articleTitle: Application of an Optimal ILC Algorithm for Flow Rate Tracking of a Ventilator System
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper considers the application of an optimal Iterative Learning Control (ILC) to a mechanical ventilator for controlling the flow rate of a ventilator during the inspiration phase. Mechanical ventilator is a medical device that produces the required quantity of air and supplemental oxygen needed for the patient, suffering from acute respiratory insufficiency. Respiration is a repeated process so ILC can be applied to control flow rate of the machine. Since medical devices demand high performance so a robust PID controller is proposed in feedback, which will help in performance improvement as well as increase tolerance to some amount of parameters variation of the system. The simulation results are obtained in MATLAB-2017.

articleTitle: State Derivative Feedback Control for Boost Converter via Linear Matrix Inequalities
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: State Feedback control is promising owing to its nature to place system poles at desired locations. Further, Linear quadratic controller achieves optimal results in addition, and is known for its inherent robustness margins. In several situations, state derivatives are readily available in contrast to states themselves. State derivative feedback has been exploited in literature for several engineering applications. Here, in this paper, state derivative feedback based linear quadratic controller is designed for DC to DC boost converter used in microgrid. The control variable chosen is duty cycle ratio required to track the reference voltage and to ensure less fluctuation in output voltage and current. Sudden change in input voltage is also considered while keeping the reference voltage constant. Simulation results verify the efficacy of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Allocation of UPQC in Overloaded Mesh Distribution System with Battery Charging Load
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper presents the allocation of the Unified Power Quality Conditioner (UPQC) effectively in mesh distribution system under different loading conditions and considering static battery charge load. The advantage of UPQC over other D-FACTS devices is that it has both shunt and series compensators so that voltage profile can be improved and power loss can be reduced more effectively. The UPQC which injects series and shunt reactive power i.e. UPQC-Q is used in this paper. The size of UPQC is found by modelling it in steady state. The UPQC is placed at all the buses one at a time and various parameters are found and analysed. The candidate bus is selected at the bus having minimum active power loss. It is seen that with the placement of UPQC at candidate bus the active and reactive power losses are reduced and voltage profile is improved.

articleTitle: Modeling and Implementation of Wind-Battery Storage Hybrid Power System in LabVIEW Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper presents a wind-battery storage hybrid power generation system which is suitable for rural areas and also for small irrigation purpose. An Adaptive Incremental Conductance (AIC) MPPT is implemented for the wind tur-bine. The wind turbine model and the battery is designed in MATLAB/Simulink. Controlling is carried out with the help of LabVIEW software. Finally, this proposed hybrid system is implemented in laboratory with the proper choice of component ratings.

articleTitle: Operation and Control of Single Phase Front End Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Conventional front end converter (employing diode, thyristor) have several disadvantages like high harmonic current, low power factor. In this paper, single phase front end converter (FEC) employing IGBT as a switching device is reported. Various aspects of single phase FEC including, PLL design, modelling, controller design for current control and DC bus voltage control are studied. Second order generalized integrator - phase locked loop (SOGI-PLL) is employed to generate the unit vector for reference frame transformation. The system modeling is done in synchronous reference frame (SRF). Further, cascaded control scheme consisting of inner current-control loop and outer voltage-control loop is implemented for current and voltage control in SRF. Pole-zero cancellation and symmetric optimum methods are used to obtain the parameters of the current and voltage controllers. Unipolar Sine triangle pulse width modulation scheme is employed for switching the IGBT devices. Modelling and design approach of front end converter are presented in detail. The system is simulated on MATLAB Simulink to validate the design parameters and the converter shows good performance under the transient and steady state conditions. Unity power factor (UPF) on the grid side is achieved with bidirectional power flow capability.

articleTitle: Digital (Electronic) Locker
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Electronic Locker is a system that is used to secure your valuable things. In this paper, an electronic lock that lock or unlock by correct sequence of four-digit key or password. These key or password can be changed at any time. Also, if a wrong key sequence is entered, then it will produce an alarm signal. Along with these if user take more than 10 seconds to press two subsequent correct keys, then it will produce a timed- out signal. The complete design of Electronic Locker is developed using Finite State Machine (FSM) and has been written in Verilog HDL (Hardware Description Language). Also, the complete design is simulated and synthesized in Xilinx ISE design suit. The complete design is also implemented on Artrix7 DDR4 FPGA hardware board.

articleTitle: Effective Placement of UPQC and DG in Radial Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper presents the placement of Unified Power Quality Conditioner (UPQC) and Distributed Generation (DG) effectively in radial distribution system. The advantage of UPQC over other D-FACTS devices is it has both shunt and series compensators so that voltage profile can be improved and power loss can be reduced more effectively. The UPQC which injects series complex power and shunt reactive power is used in this paper. The candidate bus is selected using three factors Loss Sensitivity Factor (LSF), Power Loss Index (PLI), Voltage Stability Index (VSI). The size of UPQC is found by modelling series and shunt compensators at candidate bus. The size of DG is found by variation technique at candidate bus. UPQC and DG are simultaneously placed in IEEE 33 bus system to improve voltage profile (VP) and to reduce power loss (PL).

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of MOFA Based Decentralized PI Controller of Fluidized Bed Coal Gasifier
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper propose Logically Weighted Firefly Algorithm (LWFA) to optimize the performance of coal gasifier at different operating conditions. The effectiveness of Multiobjective optimization with weighted sum of objectives has been modified by replacing Logically Weighted objective function. The parameters of the decentralized PI Controller of coal gasifier is obtained by LWFA method, resulting improved convergence and reduced simulation time. The designed controller meets the performance constraints during the pressure disturbance at all load conditions. Coal quality flexibility index for the proposed control scheme provide best results compared to existing control schemes addressed in literature. The investigations on load change test offers a smooth tracking of outputs with negligible peak overshoots and undershoots.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Analysis of Solar PV based on GUI
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Due to the economic challenges in surging oil costs and natural concern India is facing huge growth in renewable energy resources. By adopting artificial intelligence technique based input to the drive train mechanism, effective usage of the solar energy has been performed. This paper presents continuous real time monitoring of PV modules. Current - Voltage, Power Voltage characteristics graph at different isolation and temperature helps in study of 200W solar panel. Monitoring of system is based on LabVIEW Data dashboard application.

articleTitle: Novel Implementation of a Configurable Gateway Between CAN and Ethernet Protocol For In-Vehicle Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper presents the implementation of configurable gateway between CAN and Ethernet protocol for in-vehicle networks. The implemented gateway software has two independent parts: the gateway basic modules (message transmission, routing, and reception) and the configuration files (module information and rules to give references to all configured files). Configuration and generation files for required module are prepared by configuration-based software tool. Source file required for implementation of the configurable gateway architecture is written in CAPL. This implementation provides high reliability, good versatility along with large B.W. It also offers high speed besides being cost effective.

articleTitle: Control Strategy Of Bi-Directional Energy Transfer For Electrical Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: As the non-renewable energy source on earth are decreasing day by day and the world is moving towards the renewable energy source like solar, thermal, wind etc. therefore, it is the serious cause for humanity to see at the same time the lack of non-renewable energy resource. Therefore, the future vehicle will be of electrical type. As more energy is being obtained from renewable source due to limited availability of fossil fuels, the use of renewable energy like solar, thermal and wind are on increase. Due to the serious pollution in cities, the electrical vehicles are the future need. The clean electric energy can be obtained from the grid or from renewable sources. The electrical vehicle battery can be charged from grid through AC to DC converter and from solar and wind they are DC to DC converter.

articleTitle: Study of Fusion of medical images and classification comparison using different kernels of SVM and K-NN classifiers
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: In this paper, the methodology of detecting cancer, has been presented. The database consists 200 samples of PET & CT scans each. 50% of the samples were non cancerous. Wavelet based decomposition is performed for each PET & CT scan images, using haar mother wavelet with depth 5. After decomposition, averaging fusion rule has been applied for fusing the four details of wavelet decomposition (approximation, horizontal, vertical & diagonal details) to get a fused image having both details of PET and CT images. Further, these 200 fused images are segmented manually by cropping method to extract the region of interests (ROIs). GLCM technique has been used to classify images in which 17 features have been extracted. Extracted features are examined further by using support vector machine (SVM) and k-nearest neighbors algorithm (k-NN). The accuracy percentage of SVM classifier vary from 95.5% - 98% and accuracy of k-NN classifier vary from 69.5% - 95.5%. This indicates that fused images can be a more powerful tool to diagnose the lung cancer.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of STATCOM Under Different Fault Conditions Near the Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Wind power is one of the emerging renewable energy resources across the globe and has received considerable attention in case of electricity generation. Study of all parameters near the wind turbine is an essential requirement. Faults occurring near the wind turbine have very less short circuit impedance hence severity of the fault increase. Due to the fault, voltage dip is a common phenomenon occurring in any generation system. Reactive power compensation using STATCOM can improve the voltage profile of the wind farm in these situations. In this paper, grid integrated wind power system has been discussed. Both symmetrical and unsymmetrical faults are analyzed and effectiveness of the STATCOM for restoration of voltage profile is checked for respective cases. MATLAB simulation for proposed system has been done and various parameters are analyzed.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Control for Grid Connected PV System based on German Grid Code
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: With the continuous depletion of traditional fuels, renewable energy resources have been main topic of research. The solar energy is mostly studied due to the abundant amount of sunlight that is available throughout the earth. Grid connected PV system is useful in many ways as it can supply and consume the amount of power, but the grid connected PV system increases the risk of grid instability due to the lack of reactive power support. In this paper, the control scheme is implemented in order to control both active and reactive power in the system. It helps in reducing the reactive power stress on the overall system. The performance of the system is verified in Matlab/Simulation environment.

articleTitle: Estimation of Pain from Normalized Energy of IMFs of EMG Signal
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Pain is one of the most complicated and subjective sensation. As of now, doctors need to verbally communicate with the subjects for assessment of pain. In many cases, proper assessment of pain is not possible, especially for infants, deaf and dumb subjects, unconscious subjects etc. It is reported that pain stimulus excites the sympathetic nervous system (SNS) that changes the activity of few bio-signals that are directly related to SNS activities and the facial expression as well. In this present work, EMG of zygomaticus muscle which is related to change in facial expression is analyzed. Considering non-stationary nature of the EMG signal stimulated through pain, Empirical Mode Decomposition method is applied on EMG for its data adaptive nature. Standard Logistic Regression classifier is used on selected IMFs to classify between ‘no pain’ and different pain condition. Gradual increase in classification accuracy is noticed with the increase of pain intensity.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis And Design Of DCDC Converter With An Approach Of Interfacing It With MCB
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper involves the comparison of the various topology available for DCDC converter. Based on which a Synchronous half-bridge Buck-boost converter topology is selected, and its MATLAB/Simulink model is presented. Dynamics and circuit operation of this topology are also explained with its mathematical equation. The simulation presents the operation of a 24V battery when fed with source input. PI controller has been adopted for the functioning of the battery in CC/CV modes. Later the paper presents a generalized approach of making the DCDC converter MCB compliant based on AUTOSAR standards. The communication between MCB and components of EV and EVSE is suggested through CAN bus protocol. Various charging states of MCB and DCDC converter have been explained briefly when the charging process is desired.

articleTitle: Automation of Instrument Air Distribution System using PLC and incorporating Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper is mainly focused on producing a completely modernized IA distribution controlling system including PLC program and HMI package overcoming all the disadvantages with its older version using relay logic. As a further extension Industry 4.0 is incorporated by using LabVIEW as HMI and wireless interface of sensors and mimicking the IAD plant in Arduino and web-publishing the same for remote access.

articleTitle: Comparative Performance Analysis of PV module using PSO and CSA Techniques
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: In this paper, the comparative performance improvement of PV module is reported via use of meta- heuristic approaches i.e., Cuckoo Search Algorithm (CSA) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) for maximum power point tracking. These methods show lower cost, high overall efficiency and are simple to implement Both algorithms have been applied to track MPP and results are compared. In this case a MATLAB/SIMULINK environment is used and obtained result are compared under several operating condition such as irradiance, temperature and under partial shading. Results admit that CSA approach performs comparatively better in tracking maximum power as compared to PSO.

articleTitle: Design of H∞ Controller for Magnetic Levitation Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: In this paper, an H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controller for magnetic levitation system is proposed. Design and analysis of the proposed controller is done based on the linearised mathematical model of Maglev. The model used in this paper takes into account the electrical and mechanical parameters of the system. The H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controller is designed to achieve stability and robustness towards the model perturbations and external disturbances. In this proposed work the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controller gains are obtained using state space formulation. Supporting simulations are included for the validation of efficacy of the controller.

articleTitle: Wheeling charge evaluation by using proposed MW-mile method considering transmission losses and load power factor variation
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Today's electric utility industry is drastically changing due to power system restructuring. The main feature of this power system restructuring is to create a competition among the market players. It is necessary to develop a proper pricing strategy to maintain reliability and secure operation. It is a key and challenging task to allocate the charges for wheeling participants accurately. One of the pricing method widely used in India is MW- mile method for wheeling charge evaluation. This method is based on impact of power flow in a network and considers actual usage of the transmission line. There are three power flow approaches of MW-mile method namely absolute power flow, reverse power flow, dominant power flow. This method does not consider the impact of transmission loss as well as power factor variation of recipient load while evaluating the wheeling charges for the corresponding three power flow approaches. This paper compares the three power flow approaches with inclusion of transmission losses along with fluctuating power factor. The recipient should necessarily get benefit for operating their load at improved power factor. It motivate the recipient to operate their load with opitimal power factor. It also make sure that recipient should get penalty for operating the load at poor power factor. To get this accurate wheeling charge, this paper include the impact of transmission loss of line associated with power factor variation term which is set by the regulator. Newton Raphson algorithm is preferred to evaluate the line flows and line losses of the IEEE-30 bus system and corresponding wheeling charges are evaluated by using MW-mile method for all the three power flow approaches after inclusion of impact power loss as well as correction term of power factor.

articleTitle: Position and Vibration Control of Single link Flexible Joint Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This work performs to control position tracking, vibration analysis and to increase stability of the rotary flexible arm manipulator by using two control techniques. State Feedback control by pole placement method and Linear Quadratic Regulator by using Riccati equation. By applying Euler-Lagrange equation to single link flexible manipulator the dynamics of modeling includes rotational base and modeling of flexible joint. Two control techniques are compared for performance in terms of position tracking, reduction in deflection of arm manipulator, time domain characteristics and to maintain the stability of the system. Simulation is achieved on MATLAB then subsequently experimental validation of controller is also performed on the Flexible Joint Manipulator by Quanser set.

articleTitle: Structural Optimization of 2-DOF Cantilever Based Energy Harvester Using Krill-Herd Algorithm to Obtain Maximum Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Recently the piezoelectric cantilever-based energy harvesting techniques have been paid more attention to energize low power devices such as various sensors in wireless sensor networks. In this paper the structural shape of the cantilever is optimized which comprises of driver and absorber mass attached with each other with strong mechanical coupling unit. Conversion of vibrational energy into electrical energy with the help of piezoelectric sensor which is attached with cantilever beam. The modelling of 2-DOF cantilever beam is done by lumped parameter model and its frequency response is plotted. The shape of the cantilever is optimized with krill-herd optimization algorithm. The performance of the proposed optimum values of 2-DOF cantilever shows better results compared to the conventional cantilever structure.

articleTitle: Single Phase Packed-U-Cell Five Level Solar Inverter With Dual Operation Using Fuzzy Logic Controller
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Packed-U-Cell inverters can be used for low and medium power applications such as solar PV systems. In this topology less number of switches is used and yields low THD which makes it best suitable. In this paper a modified algorithm for self-balancing of capacitor voltage for five level Packed-U-Cell solar inverter is proposed. In this method capacitor voltage is reduced to half of the source voltage, from redundant states from all possible switching states. The switching scheme proposed is very simpler compared to other techniques and also a close loop control of grid connected configuration using fuzzy logic controller with grid current and voltage feedback is proposed. MATLAB Simulink model of stand-alone and grid connected configuration is developed.

articleTitle: Harmonic Reduction in Induction Motor Using Harmonic Injection Method and Passive Filter: A Comparison
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: A harmonic represents an integral multiple of fundamental frequency that is caused by nonlinear loads in a power system. Examples of loads causing nonlinearity are solid state rectifiers, saturation in magnetic devices etc. The presence of harmonics results in power quality issues in power system. And it leads to increased heating in the equipment and conductors, misfiring in variable speed drives and torque pulsations in motor etc. In this paper, an attempt has been made to reduce harmonics in an induction motor (an important component of a typical power system) existing either in current, voltage, space and time parameters using harmonic injection method. Firstly, harmonics injection method cancels up to 50th harmonics and secondly, it can achieve harmonic distortion level up to or less than 3% THD. In this paper, modeling and simulation of harmonic injection method is done to eliminate harmonics in an induction motor using MATLAB/SIMULINK environment. Superiority of the proposed method is established by comparing the results obtained with passive filter.

articleTitle: Development of Controller for Twin Rotor Multiple Input and Multiple Output System
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Present paper consider dynamic model of a twin rotor multiple input and multiple output system (TRMS). Controllability, observability, stability play a vital role in dynamic systems. In this work, pole placement is applied on TRMS for controlling and stabilization. Simulation is carried out in MATLAB for improvement of stabilization. TRMS play an important role of pitch and yaw angle control of helicopter.

articleTitle: Busbar Splitting Approach for Fault Level Management for System Integrity Protection Scheme
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: System integrity protection scheme (SIPS) is the modern day technique that is being used for the wide area protection of power system network. SIPS have been enabled for applications like voltage stability, under and over frequency protections, transient stability, etc. In this paper, a methodology for fault level management for SIPS has been developed. High fault current often leads to restriking between the plates of circuit breaker. So, in order to reduce the chance of restriking, it is necessary to reduce the fault current seen by the relay and circuit breaker. The methodology involved uses the Ward equivalent method for network reduction along with the busbar splitting methodology and check the impedance change of all boundary buses in both before and after the splitting scenarios. The boundary bus with highest change in impedance has been considered for splitting in order to reduce the fault current level. The method has been implemented for a case in IEEE 14 bus system and the simulations have been performed using ETAP.

articleTitle: Priority Scheduling based Dynamic Path Planning System with Motion Feedback
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Mobile Robots have become an integral part of the environment and one of the main focus is on multiple robot coordination systems. This research article proposes a modified grid-based A* path planning algorithm that can be used for the simultaneous planning and motion of mobile robots in a dynamic environment. The algorithm includes priority-based scheduling of robots for practical applications. It also takes into account, the re-planning of the path of the robot using motion feedback from encoders, in the case where the robot leaves the configuration space due to dynamic obstacles. A multi-robot system is set up to verify the proposed method of path planning.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment Of Conventional And Cuckoo Search Algorithm Based Centralized PID Controller For Multivariable Non-square System With RHP Zeros
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper evaluates the parameters of centralized PID controller for a non-square multivariable system with RHP zeros using Davison method, Tanttu & Lieslehto method and Cuckoo Search based tuning techniques. Simulation studies are carried out for crude distillation column having 5 manipulated variables and 4 output variables. Strong interactions among the process variables and number of PID controller parameters involved are more, meeting the performance specifications becomes very difficult with available classical tuning techniques. Hence, an attempt is made with Cuckoo Search algorithm to find the parameters of centralized PID controller. Performance of the proposed technique is compared against classical tuning methods for servo and regulatory response. Performance test results indicates that Cuckoo Search based tuning parameters outperforms the conventional techniques.

articleTitle: Performance of Motor Drive System Using Ultracapacitor
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: In this paper, a motor drive application powered with battery along with super capacitor is analyzed. For electric drives (vehicles) battery is the main source of energy during all operations. Staring and acceleration period of motor demands excessive current from the battery. The battery must supply the current which is high in amplitude and will produce energy dissipation due to high currents. It may affect the health and life span of the battery. To overcome this problem high power rating batteries are required which are highly expensive. The remedy for this problem is ultra capacitor. Ultra-capacitor will help the battery to improve its health and life span. Ultra capacitor can supply peak current in transient period because of its high-power density, high charging and discharging cycles along with longer life.

articleTitle: Power Quality Analysis of Conventional Six Pulse Converter Fed Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper presents the experimental and simulated analysis of conventional six pulse semicontrolled converter-fed systems. The six pulse converters are widely used in high power battery charging systems, UPS, soft start of induction machines, adjustable speed drives, HVDC systems, high power induction heating equipments, electric traction, electro chemical process such as electroplating and electrical heating in various industries.

articleTitle: Determination of Electrical Parameters for Surface Mounted Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: For sensor-less Field Oriented Control (FOC) of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor, the electrical parameters are required with good accuracy. The proposed method presents the estimation of Resistance and Inductance of windings of the Surface Mounted Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor using a microcontroller and Inverter circuit. Firstly the resistance value is determined by applying DC voltage across the motor phases and then inductance is determined by applying square wave across the motor phases, the experimental setup and current waveforms for both processes are shown.

articleTitle: Controller Design and Robust Performance Analysis of Magnetic Levitation System
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper presents a robust control design and performance analysis of the Magnetic levitation system (MLS). The MLS is a unstable system with nonlinear dynamics that enables an object to get suspended in air due to the effect of magnetic force produced by electromagnet with several applications in transportation sector, frictionless bearing. The ferromagnetic ball used in MLS has to be hold in hovering position due to electro-magnetic force. A robust controller has been designed using sliding mode approach to follow the ball position and stabilize it. The stability is proven by Lyapunov theory for the proposed control scheme. The practicability of the proposed controller is shown by simulation studies. A comparative evaluation is made to demonstrate the robust performance of the proposed controller designed for MLS with the proportional-integral-derivative based controller.

articleTitle: Improved Performance of Heat Exchanger using Multi-Variable Quantitative Feedback Theory based Controller
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper deals with a pre-compensated diagonal quantitative feedback theory (QFT) based controller for a multivariable uncertain plant. A 2×2 heat exchanger having linearised dynamics along with interval type of parametric uncertainty is considered as the plant. The controlled plant is required to meet a certain stability, sensitivity and robust tracking specifications. First pre-compensators are designed to make the plant a diagonally dominant one. Then, diagonal controllers are designed to make the pre-compensated plant meet the stability and sensitivity specifications using QFT. Lastly the pre-filters are designed to ensure the robust tracking requirement. The effectiveness of the proposed controller is tested through numerical simulation. The results reveal that the proposed controllers successfully control the plant with minimum coupling and interaction. The comparative study reveals that the proposed controllers outperforms some of the existing controllers in literature.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of FS3P VSI fed Induction Motor Drive using Adaptive carrier based PWM Technique
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This work proposes the performance of a 4-switch 3-phase inverter fed, cost-effective induction motor drive. The cost of inverter, switching losses and complexity due to interface circuits to generate 6 PWM logic signals reduces. The gating pulse technique here is adaptive-carrier based PWM which can be effectively used to pulse the 4-switch 3-phase inverter. Using this technique calculation time can be reduced and linear-modulation in over-modulation region can be achieved. The performance analysis of the proposed 4-switch 3-phase inverter topology fed induction motor drive is made in terms of THD in stator current and the speed response. This proposed method to fed induction motor drive using 4-switch 3-phase inverter is found acceptable while considering its cost reduction and other advantageous features.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey on Event Triggered Control for State Feedback and State Observer Based Closed Loop Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper presents a comparison between state feedback and state observer based system and application of event triggered based control techniques on various systems. Event triggered mechanism is constructed with the help of sensors and actuators to detect any error occurred and to bring back the system to its stability. Event triggered control can be feedback based or observer based, advantages and limitations of both the methods has been discussed. This paper shows how closed loop system is being controlled by applying event-based control law to build its stability and can be cost effective. This paper also discusses future trends of event triggered control in various systems.

articleTitle: Indirect Power Control Strategy for PV System connected to Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper proposed the indirect power control scheme using d-axis current control for grid connected PV system. This high generation of renewable energy increases the risk of grid instability using conventional current control scheme. In this paper variable reactive power and maximum active power is provided to the grid at different conditions using I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub> and I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub> current control scheme to improve the grid stability as compared to conventional scheme. This reduces the reactive power stress on the grid and gives a smooth control of power. This scheme is simulated in MATLAB SIMULINK and results are discussed to validate the proposed control for grid connected PV system.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking in a 3-DOF Robotic Manipulator using Sliding Mode Controller
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: In this paper the problem of trajectory tracking in 3DOF robotic manipulator device using sliding mode controller is addressed. This paper provides the mathematical modelling of robotic manipulator. For controlling the tracking error and getting smooth control torque, variants of sliding mode controller (SMC) will be applied to the mathematical model of manipulator using MATLAB simulation environment.

articleTitle: Modelling and Simulation of Grid Connected PV System for Harmonic Reduction by Using Digital Filter
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Power converters have become integral part of integrating most of the renewable energy resources into the grid. Amalgamation of these converters with the grid has been quite pragmatic but it is very much obvious every good thing has its own downside and in similar manner power converters being reliable, efficient and nearly maintenance free, have many demerits as well. Some of them being, tendency to add harmonics into the grid, reducing source and load side power factor and deviation of supply frequency. This leads to considerable rise in THD. Lots of techniques, control schemes etc. have been suggested to reduce harmonics and curtail down THD. One of the ways is adding filters to cancel the unwanted harmonics and reduce the load side THD. Previously a number of filters have been used for this purpose. They have their own merits and week points. Here we have proposed the use of digital IIR filter between load and inverter to get rid of deplorable harmonics from the system. Digital filters do not drift with temperature or humidity, or need components of precision and also they have better flexibility and reliability and there are no fluctuations due to ageing and that's why digital filters have an edge over other filters and because of expeditious design of IIR filters, they are preferred in this paper. Simulation analysis was done and the results have been justified in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Classification of Healthy, Insomnia and other Pathological Voice Samples
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Voice is the sound produced through vocal tract using lungs. It is a very important non-invasive tool to detect human body disorders. In this article, it has been experimentally demonstrated that voice analysis, can be used to differentiate between healthy and non-healthy subjects. It is proposed that voice can be used to detect sleep disorders. Computerized Speech Lab (CSL) tool from KayPENTAX (USA) has been used to process voice samples and obtain the voice parameters that clearly classify persons enjoying sound sleep and pathological persons suffering sleep disorders.

articleTitle: Recognition of Disturbances in Hybrid Grid Using Discrete Wavelet Transform and Stockwell Transform Based Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: An algorithm supported by features of both discrete wavelet transform (DWT) and Stockwell transform (ST) has been proposed for recognition of the disturbances on the grid. Voltage signals recorded on the point of common coupling (PCC) of hybrid grid test system is decomposed with the help of DWT and a proposed DWT-index is extracted. Similarly, same voltage signal is decomposed and a proposed S-index is extracted. A proposed disturbance index (DI) is calculated element by element multiplication of DWT-index and S-index. Relative values of this index indicate the level of disturbances in the test network. Classification of disturbances due to the operational events and faulty events is performed using the decision tree based on rules. It is anticipated that the proposed hybrid power grid will be effective to achieve the objective of retiring the thermal power plants in India by 2029-30 as decided by the Central electricity authority (CEA) of the India and proposed algorithm will effectively recognize the various disturbances in the utility grid. Proposed study is carried out using MATLAB software.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modelling and Comparative Analysis of Fault Monitoring of Modular Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Modular Multilevel Converters (MMC's) have become an interesting and attractive topology for dc/ac conversions and vice versa. Based upon the operating principle, large number of converter modules operate in a sequence, generating multilevel output voltages and currents. These converters differ from Neutral Point Clamped (NPC), Flying Capacitor (FC) Inverter and H-Bridge cascaded inverters because of its modular structure having series connected half-bridge Submodules (SM's) and having the capability of controlled power exchange, lesser radio interference, lower corona losses in High Voltage Direct Current(HVDC) systems which makes it more advantageous. In this manuscript, various stepped MMC's are studied and the fault detection by the effect of SM's Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT) failure on the capacitor charging and discharging have been proposed. For validating the proposed concept, the simulation and analysis is carried out on 7-level, 9-level and 11-level Half-Bridge MMC.

articleTitle: Improved Response of the Wind Energy System underIslanded Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper designs a novel control technique, using a super-capacitor (SC) storage device to improve the dynamic response and reduces the ripple from the armature current of the wind energy system (WES) under transient conditions. Permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) is used as a generator. Under sudden changes of wind energy or loads, the generator is not able to respond quickly due to the large inertia associated with it. Also, the DC link voltage has ripples due to the nonlinear loads connected to the system. These DC voltages ripple interactions with the PMSG generator produces ripples in armature current and torque. Therefore, wind energy systems, when wind speed changes frequently are having poor transients, slow dynamic responses and poor armature current.Therefore,under islanded mode, wind energy systems introduce adverse effects on other energy systems also connected to microgrid. Hence, a novel control scheme is proposed based on a bidirectional DC-DC buck-boost converter controlled SC and an inverter. Fast charging/discharging characteristics of SC. WES based control scheme is modeledand designed in the paper to obtain improved transient, fast dynamic response and reduced ripplesto mitigate the adverse effects on microgrid and wind turbine. Hybrid energy system is simulated in MATLAB SIMULINK to analyze the effects of WES and verify the effectiveness of the proposed control design under different operating conditions. Comparative results are discussed using conventional and proposed control schemes to justify the improved behavior of WES even under frequent changes in operatingand environmental conditions.

articleTitle: Comparison of Haar and Daubechies wavelet based denoising for speed control of DC motor
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper presents the comparison between Haar and Daubechies wavelet based denoising for the application of speed control of DC motor in the presence of noise. The multiresolution property of wavelet is utilized to compensate for the effect of noise in the system. In addition, the performance of associated controller is improved in the presence of uncertainty. It has been observed that similarity of the wavelet's wave shape to the signal being denoised has a direct bearing on its denoising performance. Simulation results are obtained with the help of MATLAB@2015a.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Reconfiguration and Multi Renewable DG Planning based on MOFF approach using PSO Technique
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: In the presented work an effective methodology has been proposed to reduce the active power loss, reactive power loss and voltage deviation, also considering reliability enhancement of the system. This work takes account of optimal allocation and sizing of multi renewable DG with reconfiguration using PSO technique. In this, standard IEEE 33 bus RDS is considered with different cases which includes optimal DG planning with reconfiguration based on the multi-objective function. For load flow study, BIBC and BCBV based backward-forward sweep method is used. The proposed work has been carried out in MATLAB/MatPower tool. The result analysis of standard IEEE 33 bus RDS is considered to validate the presented approach. After analyzing the obtained results, it is concluded that the optimal planning of multi renewable DG accompanied by reconfiguration based on minimization of the multi objective function using PSO technique is effective approach.

articleTitle: Optimal Generation Mix Based Design of Grid Integrated Hybrid Renewable Energy Farm with Common DC bus and Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Central electricity authority (CEA) of the India has estimated that a time period of 10-12 years is sufficient to make the relevant policies and modify system for achieving generation mix and retire thermal power plants. CEA has decided that the optimal generation capacity mix in the Indian grid may be by the year 2029-30 according the load demand of 19th Electric Power Survey (EPS). This could be achieved by combining the wind and solar power plants through a common direct current (DC) bus so that power may be stored easily in the battery energy storage devices during peak renewable energy (RE) generation and supplied to the load centres when RE power is not available. Hence, research work carried out in this paper is focussed to design a hybrid power system for integration of the wind and solar photovoltaic (PV) power plants to the utility grid through a common DC bus. Effectiveness of the hybrid power system is established by evaluating performance in terms various parameters.

articleTitle: Optimal Placement and Parameter Sizing of Unified Power Flow Controller using Meta-Heuristic Techniques
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper presents the comparative study of various meta-heuristic optimization techniques like the Cuckoo Search Algorithm (CSA), Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) & Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to examine the optimal placement and parameter sizing of the unified power flow controller (UPFC) in IEEE 30 bus system. The objective functions of this study are the reduction of the fuel cost and UPFC installation cost. The optimization problem is solved using MATLAB R2016a and GAMS software. The result of the study shows the effectiveness of Cuckoo Search Algorithm and superior performance than ACO and PSO in finding out the optimal placement and parameter sizing of the UPFC.

articleTitle: Optimum Installed Capacity with Optimum Energy Mix for Base Load Power Plants considering Environment and Cost Aspects
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: This paper focuses mainly on computing the optimum installed capacity of base load power plants considering the average hourly demand over the months of the year and the cost of generation of each of the sources of base load power plants. To compute the optimum installed capacity of base load power plants, based on the past trends three cases have been considered - lowest out of minimum of average hourly demand, lowest out of average of the average hourly demand and highest out of minimum of average hourly demand.The approximate costs of generation of each of sources used for base load, i.e. coal, gas and hydro are calculated based on data taken from the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission regulations. The proposed methodology for installed capacity has been implemented on the average demand chart of state of Maharashtra, India for the year 2018. The energy mix for base load is suggested based on the installed capacity and the cost factor. This mitigates the environmental impact to a reasonable extent and simultaneously makes these plants operate at their optimal levels with increased plant load factor and reduced energy losses thus reducing the overall cost of generation.

articleTitle: Load Tracking Enhancement of a Grid Connected SOFC System using an Advanced Controller in Real Time
publicationTitle: 2020 First IEEE International Conference on Measurement, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (ICMICA)
abstract: Modeling, measurement and control are the most important aspects, for making any renewable source to be in synchronism at the earliest with the utility grid during any load demand power change. This is to put minimum stress at the grid during load change as per the latest grid-code. Therefore, in this paper an efficient and rugged active power controller based on ANFIS has been implemented for improving the load tracking of grid connected static renewable source i.e. SOFC. Additionally, this controller is subjected to the constraint that the fuel utilization factor of the SOFC should stay within safe limits. The comparison of this proposed controller shows superior performance in contrast to conventional integral controller. The results have been verified in real time environment provided by OPAL-RT's simulator through hardware-in-loop.
